description: The plot illustrates a comparison of loss values between a vanilla Transformer model and a proposed SepLLM model across varying training times. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.70, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  A blue solid line represents the “Vanilla” model, starting at approximately 2.68 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreasing to approximately 2.43 at a training time of 250000 seconds. An orange dashed line represents “SepLLM”, beginning at approximately 2.65 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreasing to approximately 2.40 at a training time of 250000 seconds.
